# Thunderbird Calendar create/edit attribute-driven source loader

Calendar lookup ignores `AbortSignal`, so request-ID matching must reject stale results. `storeObserver` selectors depend only on Redux; translate host attributes into actions/session state. Static eslint, `node --check`, and `git diff --check` passed, but runtime tests were blocked by missing Thunderbird binary. [Task 1]

Scope: calendar.
